name: Sprite
description: Renders a sprite as an icon (sprites are located under 'textures/gui/sprites/)

fields.description: The ID of the sprite that will be rendered

name: Experience
description: Displays an amount of experience points of levels

fields.description: Amount of xp points or levels
Whether or not this will be displayed as xp points or levels

fields.description: Path to the texture, or a dynamic texture ID

Array of icons that will be displayed
